_fill_in: A TEMPLATE for ophanim/operate/live-run.mjs (schema ophanim.live-run/v2). Copy it OUTSIDE the repository and fill it in. Every limit is null here ON PURPOSE: the owner chooses each one, and the launcher refuses a null (it fills in no default). limits: total_provider_calls = the whole run's provider-call cap (calls, not dollars; an implementer session is charged one call per model request it makes, and so is each native subagent); stage_provider_calls = per claimed stage, at most the total; revisions = per-file revisions (used only without work units); stage_attempts = retries of one stage on the same inputs; elapsed_ms = the wall-clock bound of the run; pipeline.max_provider_calls (at most stage_provider_calls), pipeline.max_revisions (implementer attempts after the first, per unit), pipeline.max_concurrent_units, pipeline.verify_timeout_ms. billing holds two SEPARATE authorizations, each enforced where the money would be spent and never by the presence of a key. billing.gemini_api_primary must be true: the Google implementer is an Antigravity SDK session billed on the Gemini API with GEMINI_API_KEY (credentials.gemini_api_key is "required"), primary Gemini API execution is off unless you enable it, and a fit run cannot implement without it; no subscription login and no agy CLI is used for it. billing.metered_gemini_failover governs only the metered fallback of a single-turn Gemini seat on an Antigravity lane (a reviewer, the validator): false = a lane quota refusal is not answered by the metered API. credentials.required may also name "agy-login" when such a lane seat may be used; without it no agy check is run. require_subagent (optional; delete it if not part of acceptance): the run is not accepted without min_calls native subagents of that specialist type answered by gemini-4-hydrogen. ledgers.status_root is opened read-only; ledgers.work_root must be empty or absent (an isolated single-item work ledger is created there). out_dir is outside the repository. candidate_commit is the full HEAD the run is made against. Run with --dry-run first; then --confirm-spend "<item>@<first 7 of candidate_commit>".

billing.scope: replace: what this run may bill, in the owner's words
